blocks.title: Functions aur modules
blocks.text: Functions dobara istemal hone wale code ke blocks ko ek naam ke neeche rakhte hain; modules mutalliqa functions ko file mein jama kar ke program ko munazzam karte hain.
Mil kar yeh code ko kaarkard aur munazzam banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Module function se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Function code ka ek naam wala, dobara istemal hone wala block hai; module aisi file hai jis mein kai mutalliqa functions (aur variables aur classes) ho sakte hain.

items: Functions: dobara istemal hone wale naam wale blocks; modules: mutalliqa functions ki files.
